issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הַהֵרִימוּ' is a finite verb (perfect, 3rd person plural) meaning 'the king, his counselors, his officials, and all Israel who were present had contributed/offered' — it describes what they did (they lifted up/offered the contribution). The Chinese renders it as an imperative wish '願...都高舉起來' ('may they all be lifted up'), which changes the meaning from a statement of fact about who gave the offering to a wish/prayer. This alters the sense of the verse.
